name: Lambertian Shading with Packet Architecture
aliases: Batch diffuse shading with packet architecture
Packet Ray Tracing with Lambertian Shading
definition: Rendering technique using Lambertian shading with no shadows, employing a packet architecture for ray generation and shading to perform diffuse shading in batch.
summary: Lambertian Shading with Packet Architecture performs fast, shadow-less diffuse shading by batching rays for parallel processing while computing normals immediately to avoid prohibitive memory costs.
